## useDragPan() function

Pointer-event drag-to-pan, generic over any element with a pixel-to-data-unit scale. Spread the returned handlers onto the interactive surface (an `<svg>`<!-- -->, a `<canvas>`<!-- -->, a wrapper `<div>`<!-- -->).

If the surface contains nested elements with their own click behavior (a feature marker with a popover, say), mark them with `data-pan-ignore` so a click there opens the popover instead of being captured as the start of a drag.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function useDragPan(input: UseDragPanOptions): UseDragPanHandlers;
```
